mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the breathing drive was most worthwhile because the result brought the parts together and explained how air enters and leaves the lungs.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the diaphragm was straightforward, but its immediate result added little explanation; its role became clearer in the final result.

surprise.text: The blood CO₂ feedback was a useful addition: it showed that breathing rhythm can adjust to chemical conditions.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The named slots and pictures gave each fitting a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter. Connecting the breathing mechanism to circulation was satisfying, and I would be curious to see how another body system joins it.
